instructions: Local CLIs that measure.py drives. Each command reads the prompt on stdin and runs in a fresh empty directory. {out} is a file path the CLI writes its last message to; without it, stdout is the reply. 'json': true means stdout is Claude Code's --output-format json. Each family's outputs are graded by grader_for[family].

claude.session: claude -p in an empty temp dir per prompt: no tools, skills and slash commands disabled, no session persistence, CLI default model and sampling

codex.session: codex exec in an empty temp dir per prompt: ephemeral, user config and rules ignored, read-only sandbox, CLI default model and sampling
